title: The Wind and the Sun
description: NCERT Class 2 English (Marigold): 'The Wind and the Sun'. New words, comprehension, one and many (plurals), and a writing task, closed by a chapter test.

nodes.title: New Words
nodes.skill: Read and use the new words from 'The Wind and the Sun': wind, sun, strong, traveller.
nodes.teach_focus: What the new words from 'The Wind and the Sun' mean (wind, sun, strong, traveller); use one correctly in a short phrase.
nodes.success_criteria: Uses two or more of the chapter's new words correctly.
nodes.bridge_focus: Name just one new word and what it means.

bridge_exercises.sentence: The ___ blows the leaves off the trees.
bridge_exercises.context: Uses a new word in context.

bridge_exercises.sentence: Which one gives us light and heat?
bridge_exercises.context: Checks the meaning of a key word.

exemplars: The sun is stronger than the wind.
I have three books and two pens.

nodes.title: Read and Understand
nodes.skill: Understand the chapter 'The Wind and the Sun' and answer a simple question about it.
nodes.teach_focus: The main idea and feeling of 'The Wind and the Sun'; answer a who/what/how question about it in one clear sentence.
nodes.success_criteria: Answers a simple question about the chapter in one clear sentence.
nodes.bridge_focus: Say in one sentence what the chapter is about.

bridge_exercises.sentence: In the story, who finally made the traveller take off his coat?
The gentle ___ made the traveller take off his coat, not the wind.

exemplars: The sun is stronger than the wind.
I have three books and two pens.

nodes.title: One and Many (Plurals)
nodes.teach_focus: Add -s to make many: one cap, two caps; one box, two boxes.
nodes.success_criteria: Uses one and many (plurals) correctly in a sentence.
nodes.bridge_focus: Give one example of one and many (plurals).

bridge_exercises.sentence: Which is the correct plural of 'box'?
I see two ___ in the sky. (one bird, two ___)
bridge_exercises.context: Produces the grammar point in a sentence.

exemplars: I see two caps and three boxes.
The girls play with their toys.

nodes.title: Use It: Write a Sentence
nodes.skill: Write one sentence of your own using ideas from 'The Wind and the Sun'.
nodes.teach_focus: Write one clear sentence about 'The Wind and the Sun': who does what, with a capital letter and a full stop.
nodes.success_criteria: One complete sentence on the topic, with a capital and a full stop.

bridge_exercises.sentence: On a windy day, I fly my ___.
bridge_exercises.context: Scaffolds writing with a frame to complete.

bridge_exercises.sentence: I see two ___ in the sky. (one bird, two ___)
bridge_exercises.context: A second frame to produce the chapter's grammar.

exemplars: The sun is stronger than the wind.
I have three books and two pens.

chapter_test.title: The Wind and the Sun: Chapter Test

items.prompt: Which one gives us light and heat?
The ___ blows the leaves off the trees.
In the story, who finally made the traveller take off his coat?
The gentle ___ made the traveller take off his coat, not the wind.
Which is the correct plural of 'box'?
I see two ___ in the sky. (one bird, two ___)
